people.imagined: Dusk at the gate of the hall on the hill above the market. A caravan has just come in whole and he stands in the doorway as he always does, a little to one side so the drivers can pass, the staff upright beside him. Someone has asked him about the cage and he has not answered; he is only looking at them.
people.subject: The moment: at dusk in a doorway, he stands square and still with a staff upright at his right hand, as if the door were his to hold. Face, most important: a broad, plain, weather-brown face with a nose clearly broken and set a little to the left, a flat bump across the bridge; a heavy jaw with short black stubble; thick straight brows; small deep-set brown eyes with crow's-feet; a few grey hairs only at the temples. Hair: black, cut short, tied in a stubby knot at the crown with a strip of grey cloth. Body: broad, thick through the shoulders and neck, solid as a gatepost, slightly stooped from decades of leaning into wind. Clothing: a thick grey wool coat with a crossed collar and a full wolfskin mantle over both shoulders, grey-brown fur with a pale ruff; a leather strap across the chest holding a quiver; a bone whistle on a cord at the neck. Hands and objects: both hands rest on a long staff of dark wood worn pale and glossy by the grip, the right hand over the left; the knuckles are scarred. Background: a blurred wooden doorframe with dusk-blue pines behind and a lit lantern low in the distance. Light: warm amber from the upper left on the face, cold blue dusk behind. A faint green tint in the shadows of the fur, the hint of Wood qi. Expression: patient, level, unreadable, a man who keeps a thing to himself.

people.imagined: The counting-house at Tùng Hạ Thị in winter, late. He has just finished paying out a driver's leg and writing it down as something else, and a young warden has walked in. He laughs to cover it and the bell on his belt rings; for a moment the laugh is not quite his usual one.
people.subject: The moment: in a lamplit counting-room, he looks up from a desk mid-laugh, shoulders shaking, a little too bright. Face, most important: a round, ruddy, stout face with fat cheeks that lift into deep laugh-lines; a short squashed nose; small bright black eyes nearly closed by the laugh; a gap between his two front teeth; a thin drooping moustache of grey and black. Hair: thick grey-black, oiled, combed flat under a small round merchant cap of dark blue felt. Body: short, stout and barrel-chested, leaning back on a low stool. Clothing: a Pivot merchant's coat of dark blue-grey padded silk with a high stand collar and frogged toggles of knotted cord, the left shoulder covered by a short strip of wolfskin; a thick grey wool scarf at the throat. Hands and objects: his right hand holds a small round brass camel bell the size of an apple, swinging by its strap and mid-ring; the left hand rests on a wooden abacus on the desk. Background: a blurred shelf of cloth-wrapped bundles and a hanging oil lamp. Light: warm yellow lamplight from the upper left, a little reddish. Faint yellow-brown earth tint in the shadows, a hint of Metal and Earth. Expression: jolly on the surface, and, if you look, tired under it.

people.imagined: A cold clear morning in the shooting yard. She has just loosed an arrow and is not watching it; her eagle has already gone after it and she is looking at the young wardens down the line, counting who flinched. The three wolf ears swing on her belt.
people.subject: The moment: in a frosty shooting yard, she has just loosed a shot and is looking away from the target, straight at the viewer, mouth set. Face, most important: a small, thin, deeply weathered face, brown as old leather, lines etched like cracked mud; a hooked narrow nose; sunken cheeks; pale grey-green eyes, narrow and unblinking; a thin straight mouth. Hair: iron grey, pulled back tight into a single braid wound round the head, with two bone pins. Body: small, wiry, straight-backed, sharp at the shoulder. Clothing: a long coat of grey wool with a full wolfskin mantle in dark grey-black fur, the pelt's snarling-head flap resting on one shoulder; under it a brown leather jerkin laced up the front; a leather wrist guard on the left forearm. Hands and objects: a heavy horn-and-yew recurve bow in her left hand held low; on her left shoulder sits a grey-backed northern eagle with a pale head, a leather hood pushed back, talons gripping a thick leather pad; a cord at her belt hangs three grey wolf ears, dried and dark. Background: blurred straw targets and pale pines in frost. Light: cold white morning light from the upper left, glinting on the eagle's eye. Faint green hint of Wood qi along the bowstave. Expression: A flat, unblinking pale grey-green stare, the thin mouth set, cold and patient as a hunter.

people.imagined: The mule lines at night, a lantern on a hook. One mule is lame and he has her foreleg in his lap; she has put her head on his shoulder. He glances up when someone enters, one hand still on the hock.
people.subject: The moment: in a stable at night, he crouches with a mule's head resting against his shoulder, glancing up from tending her leg. Face, most important: a long calm face with deep lines either side of the mouth, a prominent chin, long straight nose, heavy-lidded warm brown eyes; skin tanned to dark tea; a short grey-flecked beard. Hair: grizzled black, shaggy, held back with a leather thong. Body: lean, long-armed, kneeling easily. Clothing: a sleeveless wolfskin half-cape over a grey wool coat with the sleeves pushed to the elbow; heavy leather apron over the knees, stained with salve. Hands and objects: on his right wrist a pale, ropy whip scar like a bracelet, wound all the way round; at his neck on a cord hangs a small iron bell-clapper, dull and unpolished; his left hand holds a small clay pot of salve. Beside him the long brown face of a mule with white around her eyes, ears turned toward him. Background: blurred wooden stall posts and hay. A row of mules in stalls stands behind him with their long ears turned toward the lantern, a bale of hay, and a hoof-pick hung on a nail. Light: a single lantern from the upper left, golden. Expression: soft, patient, unhurried.

people.imagined: The trailhead of the Bạch Lang road in first light. He has come back from the night patrol and is rolling his stiff arm at the shoulder, testing it; one hand touches the wolf-tooth charm. He has seen something on the road and has not yet decided to tell.
people.subject: The moment: at the edge of a pine road at first light, he rolls his left shoulder, testing a healed arm, and stares past the viewer down the road. Face, most important: a lean hard face, tanned, with a short black beard and a deep old claw scar cutting down the right cheek, three pale parallel lines; a nose flared at the nostril; black brows drawn low; dark eyes tired and hot. Hair: black, wild, tied in a short tail with a strip of leather. Body: tall, lean, hard-muscled, the left arm held a little stiff and bent. Clothing: a heavy grey wool coat with a wolfskin collar-strip, sleeve pushed up on the left forearm to show a straight crooked bone knit under the skin; leather bracers. Hands and objects: a single large wolf tooth, yellow-white and the length of a finger, hangs on a plaited cord at his chest, held between his right finger and thumb; a short bow across his back. Background: blurred pines in blue mist, a pale road. A grey fence of old pine trunks lines the road behind him, a broken wagon wheel leaning at the verge, and a pair of crows watching from a bough. Light: pale gold dawn from the upper left. Faint green Wood hint. Expression: grim, watchful, ready to be angry.

people.imagined: Crouched on the Bạch Lang road at dusk with her face almost against the frozen needles, smelling a track. She has just found it and is deciding what to say about it. She has sent a girl up here alone before and does not think about that.
people.subject: The moment: crouching low at dusk with her face near the ground, nostrils flared, she looks up sideways at the viewer. Face, most important: her left ear is plainly missing its lobe, a clean healed notch with a pale scar, large and visible beneath the hair, while the right ear is whole; a narrow face, hollow cheeks, a long thin nose with a pinched tip, grey-brown skin lined like bark; pale flat eyes, almost yellow; thin bloodless lips. Hair: dull grey, cut short and uneven at the nape, a loose wolf-tail tied through one lock. Body: spare, folded low on her heels, knees at her chest. Clothing: a grey wool coat with a wolfskin collar-strip, a leather hood pushed back; fingerless gloves of grey wool; dark trousers tucked into fur boots. Hands and objects: her bare right fingers press flat on a patch of frost and brown needles where a pale pawprint shows; a bone whistle hangs at her chest. Frost clings to the grey wool of her shoulders and a faint cloud of breath hangs in the dusk before her lips. Background: blurred trunks of dark pine, a thread of fog. Light: dim blue dusk light from the upper left, with a rim of cold white on her cheek. Faint cool-green Wood hint. Expression: still, flat, vengeful, almost pleased.

people.imagined: Walking the night patrol after counting fees all day; he stops under a milestone lantern to check the abacus in his sleeve against the road he just walked. A sound from the dark makes him tuck it away fast, guilty, though he is only counting.
people.subject: The moment: at night beside a road lantern, he has just pulled a small abacus half out of his sleeve and looks round, startled, as if caught. Face, most important: a thin, sharp-featured young face with a narrow nose, high forehead, long upper lip and quick, close-set dark eyes; a pencil-thin moustache that does not quite grow; ink-and-chalk smudges on his cheek. Hair: black, parted at the side and neat, a little oiled, the knot at the crown held with a bone pin. Clothing: a grey wool coat of an inner warden with a wolfskin half-cape on the left shoulder worn tidy; a clean white collar of the inner robe showing; pale chalk dust whitening the toes of his boots. Hands and objects: a small bone abacus with eight rows of beads half out of the left sleeve, the beads pale and glossy; the right hand holds a staff. Background: blurred night pines and a pale road, a milestone with a lantern glowing at one side. A milestone with a lit lantern and a heap of wagon ruts in the frozen mud mark the roadside, and a line of mules with bells is a dim shape down the road. Light: warm lantern light from the upper left. Faint Wood-green hint. Expression: shifty, clever, trying to look dull.

people.imagined: The shooting yard, lunch hour. He cannot sit through the meal; he has gone back out to stand at the line, jaw working, bowstring pulled to his ear, looking for a running target that is not there. The four wolf tails at his belt swing.
people.subject: The moment: standing at a shooting line with the bow drawn to his cheek, he turns his head to glare at the viewer, restless and hungry for a target. Face, most important: two deep, raw bowstring grooves are visible across the first two fingers of his drawing hand held up near his cheek, red and callused, and the glare is wrathful: a young, narrow, freckled face, a jutting jaw, thick black brows knitted together, a sharp nose, dark eyes too bright, a thin sneer. Hair: black, cropped and uneven, a stiff tuft at the front. Body: wiry, tense, rising a little on his toes. Clothing: a grey wool coat of an outer warden, the wolfskin collar-strip cut clean; a leather bracer on the left forearm; at his belt four wolf-tail tassels, grey, brown and black, hanging in a row. Hands and objects: a short, self-strung bow of pale yew, drawn; an arrow nocked with red-dyed fletching. Background: blurred straw targets, pines. At the far end of the yard stands a row of straw targets stuck with arrows, a rack of unstrung bows, and a high plank fence with the pine tops above it. Light: bright hard noon light from the upper left. Faint green Wood hint. Expression: A hot, hungry glare with jaw working and brows low, nostrils flared, restless for the target.

people.imagined: Alone on the road at night, a girl who has been sent to find sign. She has stopped to lick her cracked lips and is holding the too-big wolf's-tooth necklace out from her chest, uncertain whether to be afraid. She has found something.
people.subject: The moment: at night on a frozen path, she holds out an oversized wolf's-tooth necklace between two fingers and looks to the side, lips parted, unsure. Face, most important: a thin small face with chapped, split lips plainly red and cracked, wind-reddened cheeks and a raw nose-tip; large dark eyes, wide with alertness; thin straight brows; a small scab on her chin. Her upper lip has a bead of dark red where it has split again, her cheeks are chapped to a raw pink, and her eyelashes are frosted white at the tips. Hair: black, in two short uneven braids tied with twine. Body: slight, a head shorter than the others, shoulders hunched in a coat too big. Clothing: a grey wool coat of an outer warden, sleeves turned back twice, a narrow wolfskin collar-strip; knitted grey scarf. Under the coat a thick undyed wool shirt is buttoned to the throat, and the lining of the coat shows grey-brown fur at the cuffs; a bone whistle on a cord is tucked inside the scarf. Hands and objects: a huge wolf's-tooth, yellow-white and thick as her thumb, on a loose cord that hangs low on her chest; fingers wrapped in grey wool mittens. A short child's bow is slung across her back, its string wrapped in a rag against the damp; a small leather pouch of dried meat hangs at her hip. Background: blurred black pines, a thin moon. Between the trunks a faint line of grey tracks crosses the snow. Light: pale blue moon and starlight from the upper left. Faint green Wood hint. The moon is a thin silver sliver; its light makes the white of the tooth and the frost on her lashes the brightest things in the picture. Expression: brave and frightened at once.

people.imagined: Midnight on the Tùng Hạ road. He is chatting away to the dark, as he does, and has just turned to the viewer to include them in the conversation, mid-sentence, grinning.
people.subject: The moment: walking the night road, he turns toward the viewer with mouth open, mid-sentence, talking cheerfully to the dark. Face, most important: a round, sunburnt, peeling nose red as a radish, broad cheeks with a freckled flush, a wide mobile mouth showing a chipped front tooth, bushy brown brows lifted; dark-ringed but cheerful eyes. His eyebrows are sandy and untidy, he has dark circles under cheerful eyes from a night without sleep, and the peeling skin on his nose shows pink underneath. Hair: brown, sticking out in tufts from under a knit wool cap. Body: stocky, easy, bouncing step. He walks with a swinging, bouncing stride, his free arm waving as he talks, shoulders loose. Clothing: a grey wool coat with a wolfskin collar-strip, buttoned unevenly one hole off; a lantern-pole strap across his chest. A grey knitted scarf is wound twice round his neck, and the wolfskin strip on his collar is new and a little too small; his cuffs are short and his boots are wrapped with felt against the frost. Hands and objects: his right hand is blister-hard, the palm shown open, pale knobbed calluses across it, as he gestures; his left holds a wooden staff; a bone whistle hangs at his chest. Background: Behind him the road runs pale between the black pines and a second lantern glows far down it at the next milestone, a small orange point. Light: yellow lantern light from the upper left, deep blue night behind. Faint green Wood hint. The lantern light is orange and low, lighting the underside of his chin and his open mouth, and a single cold star shows between the branches. Expression: gregarious, open, kind.

people.imagined: The hall's yard, mid-morning. She has just sat down on a bench to mend her knee and is looking at the second grey patch on her good green silk with a mix of stubborn pride and irritation, waiting for someone to comment.
people.subject: The moment: sitting on a bench in a sunny yard, she holds her knee up and looks at the viewer with her chin raised, daring a remark. Face, most important: one pearl earring, a small one, her father's gift, against a fine-boned oval face with a straight proud nose and a stubborn chin; smooth pale skin gone a little brown from the road; sharp dark eyes, level; fine straight brows. Hair: glossy black, in a high neat knot with a jade-green silk ribbon and a pine twig. Body: slender, upright, a magistrate's daughter's posture. Clothing: a long robe of fine green silk with a stand collar, the knee reinforced twice with squares of coarse grey hall cloth, stitched on in white thread; over it a grey wool half-cape with a wolfskin strip on the left shoulder. Hands and objects: a short bow in her lap; a needle and white thread in her right hand. Background: A rack of hall bows leans on the wall and a cat is asleep on a sack, while through an open gate a caravan is just coming in. Light: clear morning light from the upper left. Faint green Wood and blue Water hint. Expression: chin raised, lips closed on an unspoken answer, bright eyes daring a remark.

people.imagined: He is at the well in the hall's yard, carrying water as he did on the three nights. Someone asked him a question a moment ago and he is about to answer a different one; his mouth is half open and his eyes slightly puzzled.
people.subject: The moment: at a well, two buckets on a yoke across his shoulders, he looks at the viewer a breath late, brow furrowed, about to answer. Face, most important: big ears sticking out from the sides of his head, wide and plainly visible, a long plain face with a mild long nose, a loose open mouth and wide-set, trusting brown eyes; freckled; a short wispy chin fuzz. His lower lip hangs a little loose, his eyebrows are thin and high, and a drop of water runs down his chin from the bucket he has just put down. Hair: black, cropped short and sticking up over the ears. Body: tall for his age, narrow, stooped forward from years of carrying water, shoulders rounded under the yoke. Clothing: a grey wool coat of an inner warden with a wolfskin half-cape on the left shoulder, clean and a little short in the sleeve; rough trousers; fur boots. The cuffs of the coat stop two finger-widths above his wrists, and a bone whistle swings on a cord; his trousers are plain dark grey and his boots are scuffed but oiled. Hands and objects: both hands hold the rope at the yoke; two wooden buckets hang, wet and shining; a bone whistle at his chest. Background: Behind him an old stone well with a wooden crank and a rope, the stone wet and dark, a low wall of the hall and a row of dark pines against a pale grey sky. Light: The overcast light is flat and even, with a faint cool shadow under his big ears, and a damp shine on the buckets, from the upper left. Faint green hint. Expression: honest, gentle, slow.

people.imagined: At the woodpile at the pass, she has just chopped the last log and is standing flat-footed with the axe resting; she's weighing the price of her firewood against a stranger's boots, eyes level.
people.subject: The moment: at a woodpile, she stands flat and easy with an axe resting on her shoulder, looking steadily at the viewer, bargaining. Face, most important: wood-chips plainly clinging on her brows and in her hair, pale gold against black; a square, freckled, ruddy face with a flat broad nose, wide jaw, small calm brown eyes, thick straight brows; a small, tight mouth. Her eyebrows are thick and straight, flecked with chips of pale wood, her cheeks are wind-reddened, and she has a small white scar through the left eyebrow from a splinter. Hair: black, in one thick braid down her back; fine sawdust sprinkles the crown and the end of the braid, so the black hair looks dusted with gold. Body: sturdy, broad-hipped, wide-shouldered, planted. Clothing: a grey wool coat of an outer warden with a narrow wolfskin collar-strip, sleeves rolled to the elbows; leather apron; thick woollen leggings. Over the coat she wears a leather apron stiff with sap, and her sleeves are rolled above elbows that are thick and freckled; the wolfskin collar-strip is trimmed neatly and kept clean. Hands and objects: a long-handled woodcutter's axe resting on her shoulder; a short bow slung over the other shoulder; a pair of stranger's fur-lined boots tied to her belt by the laces. Background: Behind her the woodpile is stacked in a tidy wall of split pine to the height of her head, the cut faces pale yellow, and beyond it a pass of white snow with a thin wisp of cloud. Light: bright cold daylight from the upper left. Faint green Wood and ochre Earth hint. The low white sun gives crisp shadows and makes the new wood glow a warm yellow against the blue-white snow. Expression: A level, unmoved look from small calm brown eyes under thick brows, the jaw set and the mouth easy, with no give in it.

people.imagined: He is lounging on a bench in the hall's yard, a size-too-fine Pivot coat open, polishing a camel bell that has never rung true. He has just copied a sum and is smiling at the page.
people.subject: The moment: lounging on a bench, he looks at the viewer with a smooth easy smile, as though he has just got away with something. Face, most important: a handsome, soft round face, smooth plump cheeks, a pointed chin dimple, a small snub nose, sleepy half-lidded eyes and a smile that is a little too ready; no marks. His eyebrows are neat and glossy as if brushed, his skin is clear and smooth, and he has a small beauty mark near the left corner of his mouth. Hair: glossy black, side-parted and oiled, a jade bead on a thin braid at the temple. Body: soft, plump and slouched. He sits with one leg stretched out and an arm along the back of the bench, taking up more space than he needs. Clothing: a Pivot-cut coat of fine dark-green brocade with silver-thread piping, clearly a size too large across the shoulders, hanging open over a grey wool warden's coat; a wolfskin strip pinned on the collar, still pristine. Beneath the brocade coat his grey warden's coat is a size too small and the sleeves are pushed up; at his throat a pale silk scarf is knotted loosely, and his leather boots are polished and unmarked by any road. Hands and objects: in his lap a small brass camel bell, as bright and unmarked as new silver, that his thumb rubs. Background: blurred wooden hall wall, a stack of crates. Behind him the plain pine-plank wall of the hall, a hook with a wolfskin hung on it, and a wooden crate stencilled only with a painted picture of a camel. Light: warm afternoon light from the upper left. Faint ochre-gold hint of Metal and Earth. The afternoon light is golden and warms the silver of the bell until it almost glows, with a soft shadow beneath the brim of his bench. Expression: lazy, charming, falsely innocent.

people.imagined: At the river road checkpoint, she is just turning her sleeve away as someone glances at it, to hide a knotted cord. She has the practised polite smile of someone who has been asked where she was born.
people.subject: The moment: standing at a roadside post, she has just tucked her left sleeve against her body so the knotted cord inside it cannot be seen, and smiles a practised smile at the viewer. Face, most important: a round, pleasant, composed face with soft plump cheeks and a small mouth, and a bright false smile, while the dark eyes stay watchful and flat. Hair: dark brown, parted and tied in two buns at the nape, a green river-reed pin in one. Body: medium height, neat, quick, keeping her left arm folded in. Clothing: a grey wool coat with a wolfskin half-cape over the left shoulder; a neat Lạc Hà river-blue scarf at the neck, half hidden; leather wrist guards. Hands and objects: from the edge of the left sleeve peeks a coil of blue-green knotted cord, six knots in a row; her right hand holds a staff. Background: a blurred river bank with reeds and mist, a ferry post. A tall post with a lantern, a ferry rope slung across the river, and on the far bank a small cluster of willows and a moored boat. Light: soft grey morning light from the upper left. Faint ochre Earth and green Wood hint. Expression: composed, polite, hiding something.

people.imagined: At the village shrine of the green pines before he leaves on the road. He has just touched a seedling pine, and a resin-stained thumb is at his lips. He is promising it something in silence.
people.subject: The moment: beside a small pine seedling, he looks at the viewer calmly, as if finishing a prayer. Face, most important: a quiet, broad-browed young face with a firm mouth, a straight nose, clear steady light-brown eyes and thick lashes; skin brown and smooth; a thin line of dark resin across one cheekbone. His lashes are long and dark, there is a small old scar through his chin, and a tiny seed of resin has dried at the corner of one eye. Hair: dark brown and short, with a few green pine needles caught above his right ear, left there as if on purpose. Body: tall, sturdy and settled, hands relaxed. He stands with his weight even on both feet, shoulders loose, hands unhurried, the calm of a man used to waiting beside things that grow. Clothing: a grey wool coat with a wolfskin half-cape on the left shoulder; the sleeves are plainly stained with amber pine resin, shining; at his collar a single bright green pine needle sewn on with white thread. Hands and objects: his right hand touches a foot-high pine seedling in a clay pot; a staff leans against his shoulder. Background: Behind him a small shrine of grey weathered boards roofed with bark, a clay incense bowl with a single curl of smoke, and a row of young pines of different heights, each one planted in a ring of stones. Light: soft green-gold light from the upper left through branches. Faint green Wood hint. Shafts of low yellow-green light fall between the branches and catch the resin on his sleeves so that it shines like amber. Expression: A quiet, steady gaze with a firm mouth and thick lashes lowered a little, as if finishing a silent prayer.

people.imagined: The second night of 1190 on the Tùng Hạ road, before he fell: he stands at the front with a bow in the stiff hand, jaw set, lit by a wagon lantern, as the hall remembers him: the first warden.
people.subject: The moment: on a night road before a fight, a big man stands braced with a bow lowered at his side, looking forward. Face, most important: a very long lantern-jawed face, jaw jutting like a spade, heavy brows, a straight nose, deep-set dark eyes, a short beard stippled grey; lines of old sun. Hair: black and grey, bound in a knot with a cloth strip. His beard is cut square and flecked with grey and the hair at his temples is white with frost. Body: huge, long-limbed, broad-chested. He stands with his feet wide and his weight forward, a hunter's braced stance, the huge shoulders slightly hunched against the cold and the left hand resting on his belt. Clothing: a thick grey wool coat with a full wolfskin mantle, leather straps crossed on the chest; a green pine needle at the collar. The wolfskin mantle is heavy, the pelt dark with damp, the fur at the edges clumped and wet; the grey wool coat beneath is mended at the elbow with leather, a quiver of arrows at his hip. Hands and objects: his right hand, stiffened from the bow, lies curled and rigid like a hook round the grip of a heavy yew bow. Background: Beyond him a crowd of small dark shapes, the wagons drawn into a ring, their covers pale and a bell hung on the lead one, and a few red points of eyes at the edge of the trees. Light: Painted as an old memorial portrait: faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened, fine cracks. A swinging lantern casts a long gold light from the upper left across his jaw, and the dead pale sky above gives nothing. Expression: grim, loyal, resolute.
